# gitmoap_group_provider_connections (Data Source)

List a group's provider connections. Only the connections defined here, not those inherited from groups above. Credential values are never returned, only references to where they are kept. Paginated with `limit` (20 by default, at most 100) and `next_token`. Reporters and above, as members of the group: a public group does not make its connections readable.

The token needs `provider_connection:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group id

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `auth_mode` (String) How a connection authenticates to its provider's cloud: `static_credentials` (stored
credentials, the default) or `oidc_federation` (nothing stored; each run assumes a cloud role
with a short-lived identity token gitmoap issues).
- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (Attributes) Who did something — a person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — with what a
client needs to draw and link them, so a page of records names its actors without a lookup each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--created_by))
- `environment_bound` (Boolean) Whether the connection is bound to environments. When it is, only a step deploying to one
of `environment_ids` may use it, and a connection bound only to environments since deleted
is usable by no step.
- `environment_ids` (List of String) The environments a bound connection may be used to deploy to. Empty when it is unbound.
- `id` (String)
- `last_rotated_at` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `protected` (Boolean) Whether only a run on a protected branch or tag may use the connection.
- `provider_id` (String)
- `scope_id` (String)
- `scope_type` (String)
- `secret_refs` (Map of String) The names of the stored credential fields, each with a reference to where it is stored.
Never the values. Empty for an `oidc_federation` connection.

<a id="nestedatt--items--created_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.created_by`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) The principal's picture, when one is known. Absent otherwise: a client derives the
deterministic avatar URL itself.
- `email` (String) The principal's address. An agent's is a generated no-reply address — the author of its
commits. `unknown` on a deleted actor and empty on a redacted one.
- `id` (String) The principal's id: a user id, a service account id or an agent id, as `kind` says. Empty on
a redacted actor.
- `kind` (String) A person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — which of the three a principal is,
and so which page it links to: a person's profile, a service account's page or an agent's page.
- `username` (String) The name to show: a person's or service account's username, or an agent's handle (which
always ends in `-ai`). `deleted-user` when the actor no longer resolves, `redacted` when the
caller may not see who it was. A closed account whose work stays is `closed-` and twelve hex
digits, a shape no open account may take, with an address under `.invalid`.
